Federico Molinari is an Argentine gymnast who specializes in the pommel horse event. He was born on September 14, 1988, in Buenos Aires, Argentina. Molinari began his gymnastics career at a young age and has represented Argentina at various international competitions.

One of Molinari's notable achievements was winning a silver medal in the pommel horse event at the 2012 Pan American Championships. He has also competed at the World Gymnastics Championships and has consistently been a top performer in his events.

Molinari is known for his technical skills and precision on the pommel horse, which has earned him recognition in the gymnastics community. He continues to train and compete at a high level, aiming to qualify for future international competitions and represent Argentina on the world stage.
